QUOTE: A registered `on_tool_call` callback approves everything that is not denied, which contradicts the header's "default-deny" description.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that a tool on neither list runs only when `on_tool_call` is registered. It never states the unconditional default-allow conclusion the item requires. It also says an unapproved call with no callback gets "Permission denied".
